normalization: NFC; collapse whitespace; Unicode L/Nd complete tokens; casefold dictionary lookup; exclude ambiguous, empty and identity mappings; one pass
grouping: Union shared canonical original and normalized strings in one key space, within each dataset

prdec_split.algorithm: descending group size; SHA256(seed:group_id) tie order; greedy minimize sum squared class deficits / targets plus 0.25 times squared total deficits / targets; train-valid-test tie order

evaluation.interval: 95% percentile, nominal, conditional on trained models
evaluation.margin_status: Investigator-selected one percentage point, not a community standard; interpret interval relative to both zero and +/- margin; not a powered equivalence test
evaluation.interpretation: Recommend a practically supported gain only when the interval lower bound exceeds +0.01; otherwise distinguish uncertain, small positive, and harmful effects. Inspect per-class harms, introduced errors and processing cost separately.
